title: SPCX IPO lockup ends — Space Exploration Technologies, 180 days after its 2026-06-11 prospectus
source: EST: the filing states more than one lock-up period (180, 280, 340, 366 days; this date uses 180, the one its lock-up sentences name most); the lock-up has an early-release trigger, so shares can unlock before this date. 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026042639/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs). Prospectus dated 2026-06-11 (read from its cover); 180 days after it is 2026-12-08. Lock-up clause: "Lock-up Agreements We have agreed with the underwriters that during the period of 180 days after the date of this prospectus (the "lock- up period"), without the prior written consent of Goldman Sachs & Co."
notes: $75.0B offering. Insiders may sell from the next session; the pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then.
